summary: Elevate your expertise with our e-learning and digital learning solutions training course. Learn to create engaging online content and boost learner success!
lede: Digital learning solutions use technology to deliver online and blended learning experiences. For L&D managers, instructional designers, trainers and HR professionals, this course covers planning and creating digital learning aligned with organizational needs. It explores how to design interactive modules, choose suitable learning platforms, and use analytics and learner feedback to assess impact and improve learning experiences.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals leading, designing, or supporting learning transformation initiatives:
audience: Training coordinators in NGOs and donor-funded projects
modules: The Future of Learning: Why Digital Matters
Choosing the Right Digital Tools and Platforms
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of learning and development principles and be familiar with basic digital tools. Experience in designing or managing training programs is beneficial but not mandatory.
